exact_blocker: The production live archive collector only passed ordinary <a href> values through historical_savills._catalogue_anchors(). On page 14 that returned zero catalogue anchors, so legacy first-party routes potentially stored in data-* attributes, form actions, onclick handlers or embedded script strings were never inspected before declaring the page blocked.
repair_implemented: Added savills_live_archive_latent_probe.py and wired it ahead of the standard oldest-first live archive pass. It scans all tag attributes and embedded scripts on the live page for first-party Savills auction/LotList/com_bidding routes; modern catalogue candidates are fetched through historical_savills, aid= legacy catalogues through the existing legacy first-party recovery path, and no property event is created unless a surviving Savills first-party lot/catalogue supports it.
next_safe_probe_if_zero: Use the exact unresolved page-14 auction dates to test concrete surviving first-party LotList/commission endpoint semantics before any Common Crawl or broad archival-index discovery.
evidence_policy: Archive summary cards alone are not sufficient for History V2 property events; property-level evidence must remain a surviving Savills first-party URL.
